findings.area: 1/4 Claims vs code: scope of the exactness claim (K3 closed forms)
findings.unit_or_file: B6-01, B6-02, B6-03, B2-01, B7-01..B7-04, X-06, X-07 | fastcalc/engine.py L659-709 and L1076-1123, refcalc/units_b.py L351-423, synth/model.py L514-555 and L107-112
findings.claim_refuted: "統合モデルは基準計算と一致した ... 入力検査の結果も変わらない" (README), models.json note "厳密な統合（近似ではない）", X-06 M1 title "合計の計算には年次系列を使わない". The equality only holds while the redundant inputs (descriptor base/slope/start/decline/steps AND the year table) agree. Nothing validates that, and the defective population (8 DEFECT_KINDS) has no such defect.
findings.evidence: Script mismatch.py (run: cd research_code && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -B <scratch>/mismatch.py). synth/model.py says "The table is authoritative". The reference sums profile.table; the engine uses the descriptor closed form (annual(), L706). (1) Scenario seed 4242, T=60, gas profile CONSTANT, table[10] tripled: reference B6-03 = 6,305,054.44, unified = 6,232,447.20 (-1.15% on B6, -0.34% on SUM-03, an under-estimate). SYS-01, SYS-02 and QA-01 are ok in both. The unified model contradicts itself: X-07 total 21,337,428.40 vs its own SUM-03 21,264,821.16. (2) Water LINEAR_TREND, table[5] doubled: B7-04 -0.20%. (3) Grid table[7] x1.5 with LINEAR_TREND demand (seed 4243, T=50): the reference follows the descriptor (X-06), the engine follows grid.table (L664-671): B6-03 +1.15%, B2-01 +2.04%. With CONSTANT demand the engine total follows the descriptor (L682) while its X-07 series follows the table. In totals-only mode X-06 returns {} so even matches_table is absent. tests/test_synth.py::test_descriptors_match_tables shows the invariant is guaranteed only by the generator.
findings.proposed_fix: Choose one authoritative representation per profile and grid. Either (a) drop the table for parametric kinds and record this as an exact input reduction, or (b) add a gate that checks descriptor against table and falls back to the table scan on mismatch (this costs O(Y), which removes the saving). Make refcalc X-06 and the engine agree on the grid source. Add a DESCRIPTOR_TABLE_MISMATCH defect to the defective scenarios. Qualify the exactness claim as valid only for inputs with consistent descriptors.

findings.area: 1 Claims vs code: K8 baseline reuse
findings.unit_or_file: SUM-08 / K8 | fastcalc/engine.py L43-47 and L890-895, bench/verify_unified.py L59-62 and L152-153
findings.claim_refuted: K8 "基準案の合計を 1 回だけ計算して保持" recorded as an exact unification that keeps the comparability conditions, and the headline "3103 ms -> 472 ms (84.8% 減)". The cache is keyed by scenario id only. The configuration that was timed (warm cache) was never compared with the reference in a state where it could differ.
findings.evidence: Script cache.py. First evaluation: reference and unified agree (baseline 24,704,978.775, saving 0.034681). After multiplying every baseline material quantity by 1.5 (same id, still COMPARED): reference baseline 32,027,215.642 and saving 0.2554; the unified model still returns 24,704,978.775 and 0.0347 (-22.9% on the baseline) until clear_baseline_cache() is called by hand. exactness() calls clear_baseline_cache() before both evaluate() calls, so 494/494 scenarios test the cold path only. The saving exists only when the same proposal or baseline is evaluated repeatedly (the benchmark repeats one scenario 7 times); a single evaluation is the 926 ms row. Memoisation is an implementation technique, which 04_VERIFICATION says is excluded ("実装技法の効果は含まない").
findings.proposed_fix: Key the cache on a content fingerprint or version of the baseline (or pass the baseline total in explicitly). Add warm-cache and edited-baseline cases to verify_unified. Use the cold figure (70.2% time, 61.9% instructions at L) as the headline and present reuse as a workflow option, not a formula simplification.

findings.area: 1 SUCCESS titles that misdescribe the code
findings.unit_or_file: M1 records of A13-01, A13-03, A13-04, X-01, A4-01, A4-02, X-12, A5-01, A5-02, A5-03, C1-01, C2-01, C3-01, C4-01, X-14 (tools/build_records.py kernel_text) | fastcalc/engine.py
findings.claim_refuted: Title "段階と係数 ID ごとに活動量を合算してから係数を掛ける（係数の乗算は行数ではなく係数の種類数）", and 05_DECISIONS reason (c) "係数を掛ける前に活動量を合算する".
findings.evidence: Script instrument.py on the M benchmark (2,000 materials, 600 equipment): one evaluate() reads factor .value 21,559 times in both detail modes, against 496 distinct factor ids used (QA-03 n_used). The unit values themselves are per-row products: L240 e_mfg = act_mfg * f, then L273, L296, L331, L364, L489, L502, L640, L653, L764, L778, accumulated into val[...] and returned as R[uid]["value"]. The (stage, factor id) table is a second accumulation used for the stage vector and gas split; QA-01 then compares the two. X-12 never enters the table (L279-280 only, no add()), so its M2 title "行テーブル核の行として統合" is also wrong. A5-01 multiplies before adding (L620-621: add("A5", GRID, kWh*factor)). GRID and REFRIGERANT lines hold emissions, not activities.
findings.proposed_fix: Either implement what the title says (in totals-only mode read unit values from a table keyed by (unit, factor id) and drop the per-row products), or reword the 15 titles to "single pass; aggregated table used for stage vector, gas split and CO2-only". Move X-12 to the group of memo values computed beside the table.

findings.area: 1 SUCCESS titles true only in totals-only mode
findings.claim_refuted: "年ごとの残存量の更新を…閉形式に置き換える", "合計の計算には年次系列を使わない", "更新年の一覧を作らず" are stated without condition.
findings.evidence: With detail=True (the "全出力" configuration behind the 472 ms headline) the per-device year loop still runs in addition to the closed form (L599-609), the electricity year loop runs whenever detail is on or any profile is non-constant (L661-679), and event lists are built (L565; for refrigerants always, L587). X-06's own output is produced by the same year loop as the reference (L1059-1072), or is {} in totals-only mode. In the M benchmark the electricity profile is LINEAR_TREND and gas is TABLE (instrument.py), so the constant-demand closed form is not exercised there.
findings.proposed_fix: State the condition in each title (totals-only; all three electricity profiles constant). Record X-06 M1 as a simplification of B6-01 and X-11 via G(T), not of X-06 itself.

findings.area: 2/7 Criterion for unified vs kept outside; count of formula kinds
findings.unit_or_file: B1-01, STO-01, STO-02 versus X-12, B3-02, X-11, X-17, X-09, X-10, X-13 | 03_MODELS/models.json, 05_DECISIONS/README.md table "統合前後の変化" | engine.py L279, L416, L548, L580, L742, L897-934, L937-948, L1008
findings.claim_refuted: "66 単位が 8 つの統合モデルに…まとまった", "計算式の種類 69 -> 11（84.1％ 減）", and the stated reason for keeping three units out ("参考値（段階合計の外）…行テーブルへ入れていない").
findings.evidence: X-12, B3-02, X-11, X-17, X-09, X-10 and X-13 are also outside the stage totals and are also computed beside the line table, yet they are recorded as M2 SUCCESS. B1-01 is computed in the same refrigerant pass as K4 (L580), and STO-02 uses the same fac() and conv() (L937-939), yet they are recorded as not unified. The 66/3 split therefore follows no consistent rule. K6 ("検査規則表") has no rule table in code: nine separate inline predicates remain, and QA-02 is a second pass over equipment and refrigerants (L927-933). Its key "出所ごとに 1 回" is not implemented: 20,614 provenance lookups for 3 provenance records, about 13% of totals-only time at M (instrument.py, profile_engine.py). K5 says B2-01 is a linear function of the stage vector, but b2 is computed at L738 before the vector exists. Protocol M2 requires "共通の関数と少数のパラメータ"; "11" counts labels, not formula forms.
findings.proposed_fix: Define M2 membership operationally (for example: value is read from the shared table or produced by a shared parameterised function). Then either count B1-01, STO-01 and STO-02 as unified through a MEMO stage tag, or reclassify the memo-type units. Report formula-kind reduction as distinct functional forms left in code. Rename K6 to "checks merged into the single pass" or build the rule table. Memoise input state per provenance record.

findings.area: 3/4 Load figures: garbage-collector artefact
findings.unit_or_file: 04_VERIFICATION/unified_model_load.json (L), README headline, 02_RANKING/axis_a_measurements.json (C2-01)
findings.claim_refuted: "計算時間は 3103 ms から 472 ms（84.8％ 減）… 同じ言語・同じ機械 … 実装技法の効果は含まない". The wall-time reductions at L are partly Python cyclic-GC overhead in the reference, not formula effects.
findings.evidence: In the JSON at L, reference_all / reference_without_SUM-08 is 2.13 in time (3103 / 1459 ms) but 1.387 in instructions (S: 1.43 vs 1.40; M: 1.29 vs 1.385). Script timing.py, 3 repeats at L on a shared machine: GC on: reference 3157 ms, without SUM-08 2089, unified cold 999, warm 615, totals-only 396. GC off: 1990, 1543, 967, 559, 414. So about 37% of the reference time is GC, and the reductions fall from 80.5% to 71.9% (warm) and from 68.4% to 51.4% (cold). Axis A shows the same artefact: C2-01 at L takes 461.66 ms for 1,240,150 instructions (372 ns per instruction against a median of 12; M takes 1.84 ms, so x251 for x10 rows) and is shown as 14.06% of time in 02_RANKING/README (axis_a_anom.py). The A score itself is robust because a1 is a median of per-size ranks.
findings.proposed_fix: Use the instruction counts (80.1% warm, 61.9% cold) as the primary load metric. Report wall time with GC disabled, or with GC time separated. Mark the C2-01 time at L as a GC artefact. Report min as well as median.

findings.area: 6/7 M6 SUCCESS records are not hybrids
findings.unit_or_file: M6 SUCCESS of B2-01, B3-01, B4-01, B4-02, B6-01, B6-02, B6-03, B6-04, B7-01..B7-04, X-06, X-08 (14 records) | 03_MODELS/records/units.json, PROGRESS.md column M6
findings.claim_refuted: M6 is "厳密計算と近似計算の併用" (amendment item 3-6, protocol P8). The ledger shows M6 "成功" for 14 units and 132 SUCCESS in total.
findings.evidence: Script ledger_checks.py: all 14 M6 SUCCESS titles say "どちらも厳密" or "厳密"; they are an exact fast path plus an exact fallback, which is M1 dispatch. B2-01 M6 ("閉形式でも年次計算でも同じ 1 回の乗算") is not a combination at all. The only true hybrid candidate, AP-12, is on HOLD. This also conflicts with README item 5, "近似は採用しなかった".
findings.proposed_fix: Record these 14 as part of M1 and set M6 to NOT_APPLICABLE or REJECTED with the tested hybrid. Restate SUCCESS as 118 (52 M1 + 66 M2). If any M6 is kept as SUCCESS, state the applicability test and the fallback rule.

findings.area: 2/6 The three units kept outside: completed status without any verified record
findings.unit_or_file: B1-01, STO-01, STO-02 | 05_DECISIONS/progress_ledger.json, 03_MODELS/records/units.json, 02_RANKING/axis_b_judges/*.json
findings.claim_refuted: Status "検証完了・近似不採用" for 3 units, against amendment item 5 "未検証のものを完了扱いしないこと" and protocol P8 ("近似できない" needs a tried content and a reason).
findings.evidence: ledger_checks.py: for each of the three units all six records are NOT_APPLICABLE with verification NOT_VERIFIED; no candidate was tested or rejected. Protocol P10 defines NOT_VERIFIED as "どの段階にも検証結果がない", which also matches them. The study's own axis-B judges gave concrete proposals that no record examines (judges.py). B1-01: all three judges propose M_d = m0*GWP computed once and used as the common multiplier of B1-02..04, which makes B1-01 the activity term of K4; the 03_MODELS master formula already lists the charge cycle as a multiplier. STO-01: b7 = 3 from all three judges, with a species table s_k = rho*cf*44/12 so that S = sum s_k*V_k, plus the approximation S ~ s_bar*V_total. STO-01 and STO-02: a shared memo ledger tagged storage/uptake (two judges).
findings.proposed_fix: Examine and record: (M2) B1-01 as the K4 activity with per-device multipliers; (M2) STO-01 and STO-02 as MEMO-tagged lines of K1 or a shared memo ledger; (M3/M4) the species-table input reduction and s_bar*V for STO-01. Otherwise set the status to a non-completed state. Use DONE_APPROX_REJECTED only when at least one candidate was actually tested.

findings.area: 2/6 The unit on hold
findings.unit_or_file: X-16 | progress_ledger.json (six steps NOT_DONE, 0 records), 06_OPEN_ISSUES C-5, 01_LEDGER/sheet_family_coverage.json (SF-54 物価, SF-55 物価補正)
findings.claim_refuted: "データ・権利上の制約により保留: 費用の入力項目と物価指数が入力仕様（124 項目）に存在せず、利用できるデータもない".
findings.evidence: The other additional units were defined with new inputs (25 distinct "NEW:" inputs are referenced in 01_LEDGER/units.json) and fictional values, so a fictional price index and cost input were equally available. 06_OPEN_ISSUES C-5 itself says "式は定数倍". All three judges give the form f'_y = f_cost * P_base / P_y as a precomputed column of the factor table ("汎用の活動量×係数の形に載る", b7 = 3 from one judge). M1 and M2 can therefore be concluded analytically and with synthetic data; only real-data accuracy needs holding.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a reference unit X-16 with NEW: inputs (cost, price year, index table), put the deflator into factor resolution (K7) or the factor column (K1), verify exactness on fictional data, and keep on hold only the question of real index data. Or state plainly that the hold is a scoping decision, not a data or rights constraint.

findings.area: 1/6 Evidence behind the records
findings.unit_or_file: tools/build_records.py plan() and main() | 03_MODELS/records/units.json (132 SUCCESS, 31 REJECTED, 217 NOT_APPLICABLE)
findings.claim_refuted: "SUCCESS は検証出力に裏付けがあるものだけ（…裏付けがなければ生成が失敗する）", verification "VERIFIED_ANALYTIC_AND_SYNTHETIC" on 150 records, and reasons present for every REJECTED / NOT_APPLICABLE.
findings.evidence: (a) The only check behind an EX record is that the unit's outputs matched (ex["failures"] == 0). Titles and K-membership are hand-typed in plan(), and all 132 SUCCESS reasons are one template (ledger_checks.py). An M1 title can say anything, which is how the titles above passed. (b) No derivation is cited for the 66 M2 records; evidence lists only the exactness JSON and engine.py. (c) REJECTED records for B5-01, X-08 and X-10 (AP-01, AP-02, AP-03) quote B4-stage errors; the effect on B5 and on the X-10 masses was never measured. approximation_study.json lists AP-03 for B4-01/02/03 only, while the records attach it to six units. AP-11 is recorded as M4 for SUM-03/04/05 and as M5 for X-02 and X-17. (d) Reasons that are wrong or empty: A13-04 M3 and X-12 M3 say "活動量×係数の線形和" but the forms are e*r/(1-r) and act/lf; X-15 M4 and M5 say only "同上。"; the M5 reason for 52 units is one sentence with no test; M3 for X-04, X-05, X-03 and A13-02 assert error behaviour ("必ず過小評価", "誤差が出る") with verification NOT_VERIFIED.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a machine-checkable assertion for each M1 mechanism (operation or call counters, as in instrument.py). Cite a derivation for each analytic label or downgrade it to VERIFIED_SYNTHETIC_ONLY. Measure a candidate on the unit it is recorded for. Replace boilerplate NOT_APPLICABLE reasons with a tried candidate or an analytic argument specific to the unit.

findings.area: 2 Missed exact simplification (M1/M6): electricity with linear demand
findings.unit_or_file: B6-01, B6-03, B6-04, B2-01 (and AP-08) | fastcalc/engine.py L661-682
findings.claim_refuted: B6-01 M1/M6 "一定なら閉形式、そうでなければ年次計算" and AP-08 rejected because of the demand-factor correlation; no closed form was examined for non-constant demand.
findings.evidence: Script missed.py. Candidate: with parametric demand, generation and export, net_k = B + S*k; if B >= 0 and B + S*(Y-1) >= 0 the clamp never acts (a two-point guard), and E_elec = B*G(T) + S*H(T) with H(T) = sum_k w_k*k*g_k, one more cumulative per grid scenario (closed form for CONSTANT, LINEAR and STEPWISE through sum k and sum k^2; one scan for TABLE). On the study's population (seed 20261111) all 131 scenarios with LINEAR_TREND demand satisfy the guard, and the formula equals the reference to 1.1e-15. The engine uses the year loop for all of them (33% of the population), and AP-08 shows -4.3% to +11.8% on that subgroup.
findings.proposed_fix: Add H(T) to closed_forms and the guarded linear path to K3, with fallback to the loop when the guard fails. Record it as M1/M6 for B6-01, B6-03, B6-04 and B2-01. Load impact is small (Y is about 60); the gain is one more loop removed and AP-08 becoming unnecessary.

findings.area: 2/4 Missed exact simplification (M1): changing T
findings.unit_or_file: 03_MODELS/README.md ("T を変えても式は同じで、乗数を計算し直すだけでよい"), AP-14 rejection reason | fastcalc/engine.py (functions: evaluate, clear_baseline_cache only)
findings.claim_refuted: The statement that a change of study period only needs the multipliers recomputed, and the AP-14 reason "統合モデルは評価期間を引数として厳密に計算でき十分に軽い".
findings.evidence: Script tsweep.py. The engine has no multiplier-only entry point; a different T re-scans every row (about 40 ms at M). Prototype for B4: aggregate U_c once per distinct cycle (869 cycles for 2,600 rows, plus 93 explicit lists), then B4(T) = sum_c N(T,c)*U_c. For T = 30, 42.5, 50, 60 this equals the engine to about 1e-15 and takes 0.3-0.5 ms. The same split works for B3 (R_c*(T - skip(T,c))) and for the gas split with (cycle, factor id) keys. A judge proposed this ("T の感度分析は O(周期の種類数)").
findings.proposed_fix: Split evaluate() into a T-independent aggregation (A[s,f], U[c,f], R[c,f], refrigerant parameters) and a T-dependent multiplier step. Verify it against the reference over a set of T values and report the cost per additional T. Until then, reword the README sentence as a property of the formula, not of the implementation.

findings.area: 2 Missed opportunities proposed by the study's own axis-B judges and not examined
findings.unit_or_file: 02_RANKING/axis_b_judges/*.json versus 03_MODELS/records/units.json | X-06, A4-01, X-12, C2-01, C3-01, C4-01, A13-04, B3-01, B4-02, B5-01, X-07, X-17, X-15, SYS-01
findings.claim_refuted: Amendment final instruction ("近似化・統合できる可能性を可能な限り取りこぼさない") and protocol P8. Units scored "clearly replaceable" have NOT_APPLICABLE steps with no tested candidate.
findings.evidence: Script judges_vs_records.py: 12 units with median b6 >= 2 have M3 = NOT_APPLICABLE (A13-01, X-17, A4-01, A13-04, X-07, SUM-08, STO-01, B6-02, B7-01..04; the last five are covered by exact M1). 10 units with median b7 >= 2 have M4 = NOT_APPLICABLE (X-13, X-09, X-15, X-06, X-10, SUM-08, QA-03, QA-04, STO-01, B6-04). Concrete proposals with no record (judges.py): (1) X-06, M2: one knot table plus interpolation mode for all four grid kinds, with G(T) from per-interval arithmetic series (scores of 3 from all judges); the engine keeps four branches; risk: step and floor edges. (2) A4-01, X-12, C2-01, M2: one tonne-km kernel sum (f/lf)*TKM with a stage tag; M3/M4: mass-weighted mean distance; risk: a simple mean under-estimates when heavy items travel far. (3) C3-01, C4-01, M2/M4: phi_{c,s} = sum_r p_r*f_r per material class so rows need mass only; exact if routes are common in a class; risk: row-specific routes. (4) A13-04, M3: h(r_bar)*E_A13 (exact for uniform r) and the safe-side chord r/(1-r_max); risk: non-uniform r. (5) B3-01, M4: class-level repair rate sum_k r_k*(T*E0_k - sum N_i*e0_i). (6) B4-02, M6: use sum u*(T/c-1) and sum u*T/c as a guaranteed bracket instead of point estimates. (7) B5-01: NONE as phi = 0 removes a branch input. (8) X-07: closed-form cumulative c(t) from the same multipliers evaluated at t. (9) X-17 and AP-10: add an "other" class or coverage gross-up; AP-10 was tested without it. (10) SYS-01 and X-15: state per provenance record, and the resolver memoised per (factor id, unit), including the EPD validity test.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a traceability table from each judge proposal with a score of 2 or more to a record (tested, rejected with measurement, or reasoned out). Test at least items 1 to 4, 6 and 9 on the fictional population and record outcomes.

findings.area: 6 Emphasised step M4 has no concluded result; narrow candidate set
findings.unit_or_file: 03_MODELS/records/units.json steps M4, M5, M6 | README progress table
findings.claim_refuted: "検証完了" for 69 of 70 units, read against directive chapter 4-③ and amendment item 4 (most resources to common approximate models across different formulas).

The four M4 candidates (AP-10, AP-11, AP-13, AP-15) are one family: floor area or summary quantity times a mean intensity per (structure, use). findings.area: 7 Internal contradictions in the sheet-family mapping
findings.unit_or_file: 01_LEDGER/units.json (sheet_family_links) versus 01_LEDGER/sheet_family_coverage.json (related_units); 01_LEDGER/sheet_families.json; 05_DECISIONS/README.md K-table; README list of 9 uninspected families

findings.evidence: readme_numbers.py: units.json references 113 distinct inputs, 88 existing plus 25 "NEW:" ones; the row counts only the 88. The figure comes from ledger declarations, not from what the engine reads. Exact input reductions exist and were not counted or examined: year tables of parametric profiles are never read in totals-only mode (see the first finding), M_d for refrigerants, B5 NONE as phi = 0, class-level route or repair parameters where they are uniform.
findings.proposed_fix: Report 113 (88 + 25 new). Measure the inputs actually read by the unified model per output mode. Separate exact input reductions (redundant or derivable inputs) from approximate ones before concluding that inputs cannot be reduced.

findings.area: 4 Over-claim wording
findings.unit_or_file: 09_APPROX_STUDY/README.md 結果の要点 items 2 and 7; 03_MODELS/README.md "全体を 1 つの式で書くと"; 00_POLICY/EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md P7 line 152 and P5; 01_LEDGER/units.json authorship_note
findings.claim_refuted: "材料・用途・構造の違いは式には現れず…" and "全体は…1 つの式…で書ける" presented as results; "独立した担当による反証検査を行い"; "3 名の評価者" / "独立した分析担当 2 名".
findings.evidence: Item 7 is true by construction of the independent model (one formula was designed for all materials, uses and structures; the differences are generator parameters). Nothing was learned about whether the original has per-discipline formulas; separate sheet families 空/衛/電/昇 exist and are mapped to the same units by name only. The sentence carries no "独立概念モデルでは" qualifier. The "one formula" holds only because GRID and REFRIGERANT lines carry emissions with pseudo-factor 1, and checks, factor resolution and indicators are outside it. No record of an independent refutation check exists in the tree (grep for 反証 finds only the protocol sentence). The documents do not say whether the evaluators and analysts are people or automated agents.
findings.proposed_fix: Prefix both result sentences with "独立概念モデルでは（設計上）". Change P7 to "反証検査を行う" until a log is filed, then link it. State what the judges and analysts are.

overall:
The bookkeeping is sound, but several headline claims are stronger than the code and records support.

What holds: all 54 README numbers I recomputed match the JSON. The ledger satisfies the formal amendment rules (70 units, six states, no completed unit with a NOT_DONE step, reasons present, top-30% used only as reference, deliverables 1-9 present). No restricted file types, no UI or product code, and no licensed-looking values were found. Scope disclaimers (independent conceptual model, fictional data, originals not inspected) are present in almost every document. The unified model does reproduce the reference on the verified population, and at size L in my own check.

What does not hold as stated:
- **Exactness is conditional.** K3 equals the reference only while the redundant descriptor and year-table inputs agree. Nothing checks this, and a one-year table edit gives a silent under-estimate of 1.15% on B6. K8 returns a stale baseline after the baseline is edited (-22.9%), and the warm-cache path behind the 84.8% headline was never compared with the reference in a state where it could differ.
- **Fifteen M1 records describe a mechanism the code does not implement.** The factor is still multiplied on every row: 21,559 factor reads against 496 distinct factors. This passed because a SUCCESS record is validated only by output equality of the unit, not by the stated mechanism.
- **The counts "66 units into 8 models" and "69 -> 11 formula kinds" rest on an inconsistent rule.** Memo-type units computed beside the table are counted as unified, while B1-01, STO-01 and STO-02 are not. K6 is nine separate inline checks, not a rule table. The 14 M6 "successes" are exact dispatch, not exact-plus-approximate hybrids.
- **Wall-time reductions at L are inflated by garbage collection** in the reference. With GC off I measure about 72% (warm) and 51% (cold), against the quoted 84.8% and 70.2%. The instruction counts (80.1% and 61.9%) are the defensible figures.
- **The emphasised step M4 has no concluded result for any unit** (43 HOLD, 30 not applicable), with all four candidates from one area-intensity family. Three "completed" units have no verified record at all. X-16 is on hold although its exact unification needs no real data. One README sentence says all units through wave 3 were verified, which the ledger contradicts.
- **Opportunities were missed**, including several proposed by the study's own axis-B judges. Two I verified: an exact closed form for linear electricity demand (131/131 scenarios, 1e-15), and a multiplier-only re-evaluation for a changed T (exact for B4, about 100x faster at M). Others are listed in the findings.

Recommended before the study is presented: qualify the exactness claim and add the descriptor/table and cache cases to the verification; correct the misdescribing record titles and the M6 and unit-count bookkeeping; lead with instruction counts; and add a traceability table from judge proposals to records.
